Native and owning incremental APIs bound each call to 1-65536 state-machine dispatches (default 4096), report actual work and resume yielded partial state/EOF, including zero-I/O yields. Owner-side cancellation/reset/direct unfinished close, retained output and eight 512 KiB-stack workers are tested. 6000 codec fixtures (928 new work cases), 388 counted allocation-failure/retry cases and native/Luce suites pass in all six local and Linux/macOS CI modes plus ASan/UBSan. Disk-interrupted local gates were rerun after cleanup, not counted as passes. Verified nine-binary/six-script Linux bundle passed isolated VPS suite with unchanged live services. Dispatch bounds are not deadlines or asynchronous close; 590736-byte allocation ledger is not process/aggregate memory. Languages and image source unchanged. M1a measured memory/latency and further stress/fuzz gates remain open; full Git, registry and standalone luc acceptance are later gates.

Five quick cases plus the existing 6000 codec/388 allocation/native/Luce suites pass in all six local and Linux/macOS modes, ASan/UBSan and isolated VPS. Eleven full native-opt-3 cases pass locally and on both CI hosts, including 16/128 MiB growth checks and a 4294967297-byte stream without large files/allocations. OS metrics include startup/runtime effects; paired pipeline, timing and memory observations are not independent oracle coverage, deadlines or aggregate server capacity. Production codec, languages and image unchanged. M1a independent larger-stream/fuzz validation and M0 review remain open; no Git service, real registration or luc acceptance claim.

Independent bounded decoder fuzz batches and larger file-stream oracles. Exact stage removed and all live services unchanged. Production codecs/languages/image unchanged. Planned compression validation has local/CI/VPS evidence; M1a remains in progress because M0 is incomplete. No exhaustive/coverage-guided/independent-security-review, full Git, registry, deployment or real luc acceptance claim.

Exact stage removed, live applications and reverse proxy unchanged, corpus hashes identical across three Python versions. Relocated macOS prebuilt suite also passes and its temporary stage was removed. No foreign crypto runtime, language-source change, real credential or live service mutation.
